title: Service Delivery Manager
meta_desc: Service Delivery Manager job in Valletta, Malta: lead IT support services, SLAs and KPIs for a major European client. ITIL MP/SL required. Apply now.
experience: Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience managing support services
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in IT; minimum 10 years managing support services; valid ITIL Managing Professional (ITIL MP) or ITIL 4 Strategic Leader (ITIL SL) certification or equivalent
about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, an IT services company, for an experienced Service Delivery Manager who is fluent in English and will be based in Malta, working from Valletta.

For the first assignment, you will join the company's Development team and work closely with a major client's IT team, both on site and off site. The client is a major European institution, so the setting is international, multilingual and multicultural.

You will be the main management contact for service performance and escalations, supervise a multidisciplinary team, keep delivery in line with contractual SLAs and KPIs, and drive continuous service improvement. The role is full-time and on-site, with competitive remuneration based on qualifications and experience.
responsibilities: Act as the main point of contact for the management team on service performance, delivery oversight, incident escalations and continuous improvement
Oversee and direct the daily activities of a multidisciplinary team, keeping resource allocation and scheduling aligned
Run monthly service reviews with management, Tower Leads, Service Managers and the PMO covering SLA performance, open incidents, change requests and improvement actions
Ensure overall compliance with contractual Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and report on them
Address client feedback directly so that services keep meeting customer expectations and organisational needs
Drive continuous service maturity (CSI), oversee problem records for recurring incidents and propose optimisation measures
requirements: Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience managing support services
Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and engaging stakeholders
Experience with SLA and KPI tracking
Experience with service catalogue lifecycle management
Experience with vendor governance across complex environments
Mandatory: a valid ITIL Managing Professional (ITIL MP) or ITIL 4 Strategic Leader (ITIL SL) certification, or equivalent
offer: Competitive salary — remuneration on a contract basis or with a full benefits package, based on qualifications and experience
Work as part of a team serving a major European institution
An international, multilingual and multicultural working environment
A dynamic company where you can make a real difference
skills: SLA and KPI monitoring and reporting
company: Our client is an IT services company that places experts with a major European institution, working in an international, multilingual and multicultural environment in Malta.
location_text: Valletta is Malta's compact capital and a UNESCO World Heritage city between Grand Harbour and Marsamxett Harbour; its bus terminus at the City Gate links it with every part of the island.
